entities.summary: Damjan Dervarič is a Slovenian professional ice hockey player who is currently on a try-out contract with HKM Zvolen of the Slovak Extraliga. He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Slovenia men's national ice hockey team.
